svg.title: Two-pump rotation - IEC FBD review diagram
svg.desc: Nine ordered networks. Named connectors join signals between blocks and networks. Not a compiled Schneider project.

g.text: LeadPump = 1 -> Pump1 | LeadPump = 2 -> Pump2 | LeadPump RETAIN
RotationTime: adjustable TIME | TaskPeriod: T#100ms | SEL: FALSE selects IN0; TRUE selects IN1
Execute top to bottom. Snapshot state BEFORE later networks write it. FirstScan is supplied by the PLC platform.
Network 1/9 | Named boxes are signal connectors; identical names are connected. Arrows show data flow. IEC review diagram; not compiled for TM172.
02 | Start / feedback supervision and latched StartFail
LeadPump = 1 -> Pump1 | LeadPump = 2 -> Pump2 | LeadPump RETAIN
RotationTime: adjustable TIME | TaskPeriod: T#100ms | SEL: FALSE selects IN0; TRUE selects IN1
SR is SET-dominant. Reset is accepted only when the previous RUN command is OFF. TON also detects sustained feedback loss.
Network 2/9 | Named boxes are signal connectors; identical names are connected. Arrows show data flow. IEC review diagram; not compiled for TM172.
03 | Pump availability / unavailable alarms / feedback conflict
LeadPump = 1 -> Pump1 | LeadPump = 2 -> Pump2 | LeadPump RETAIN
RotationTime: adjustable TIME | TaskPeriod: T#100ms | SEL: FALSE selects IN0; TRUE selects IN1
AllPumpsUnavailable is independent of Demand. NoPumpAvailableAlarm requires Demand.
Network 3/9 | Named boxes are signal connectors; identical names are connected. Arrows show data flow. IEC review diagram; not compiled for TM172.
04 | Selected / standby pump and confirmed-running condition
LeadPump = 1 -> Pump1 | LeadPump = 2 -> Pump2 | LeadPump RETAIN
RotationTime: adjustable TIME | TaskPeriod: T#100ms | SEL: FALSE selects IN0; TRUE selects IN1
Time accumulation requires previous RUN command AND the matching RunFeedback. RunCmd alone is insufficient.
Network 4/9 | Named boxes are signal connectors; identical names are connected. Arrows show data flow. IEC review diagram; not compiled for TM172.
LeadPump = 1 -> Pump1 | LeadPump = 2 -> Pump2 | LeadPump RETAIN
RotationTime: adjustable TIME | TaskPeriod: T#100ms | SEL: FALSE selects IN0; TRUE selects IN1
One pulse per rising edge. A request rejected because the standby pump is unavailable is NOT queued.
Network 5/9 | Named boxes are signal connectors; identical names are connected. Arrows show data flow. IEC review diagram; not compiled for TM172.
06 | Accumulated rotation timer / TIME arithmetic / RotationDue
LeadPump = 1 -> Pump1 | LeadPump = 2 -> Pump2 | LeadPump RETAIN
RotationTime: adjustable TIME | TaskPeriod: T#100ms | SEL: FALSE selects IN0; TRUE selects IN1
100 ms cyclic task; TaskPeriod = T#100ms. Demand gaps HOLD time. Saturation prevents overflow. Invalid RotationTime disables timed rotation.
Network 6/9 | Named boxes are signal connectors; identical names are connected. Arrows show data flow. IEC review diagram; not compiled for TM172.
07 | Emergency switching / timed and forced rotation arbitration
LeadPump = 1 -> Pump1 | LeadPump = 2 -> Pump2 | LeadPump RETAIN
RotationTime: adjustable TIME | TaskPeriod: T#100ms | SEL: FALSE selects IN0; TRUE selects IN1
Emergency switching is independent of the rotation timer. Only one switch event is evaluated from LeadBase per scan.
Network 7/9 | Named boxes are signal connectors; identical names are connected. Arrows show data flow. IEC review diagram; not compiled for TM172.
08 | Commit LeadPump / RotationElapsed reset or hold / RotationDone
LeadPump = 1 -> Pump1 | LeadPump = 2 -> Pump2 | LeadPump RETAIN
RotationTime: adjustable TIME | TaskPeriod: T#100ms | SEL: FALSE selects IN0; TRUE selects IN1
LeadPump is RETAIN. RotationElapsed is NOT RETAIN: reset on FirstScan or switching; otherwise commit the accumulated value.
Network 8/9 | Named boxes are signal connectors; identical names are connected. Arrows show data flow. IEC review diagram; not compiled for TM172.
LeadPump = 1 -> Pump1 | LeadPump = 2 -> Pump2 | LeadPump RETAIN
RotationTime: adjustable TIME | TaskPeriod: T#100ms | SEL: FALSE selects IN0; TRUE selects IN1
The ONLY writers of Pump1_RunCmd and Pump2_RunCmd. EQ(LeadNext,1) and EQ(LeadNext,2) cannot both be TRUE.
Network 9/9 | Named boxes are signal connectors; identical names are connected. Arrows show data flow. IEC review diagram; not compiled for TM172.
